title: What if you jumped into a hole through Earth? 🕳️
subject: earth
description:
Would you take the jump? 👇

What would happen if you fell into a tunnel through the center of the Earth? A 2015 physics study says 38 minutes to the other side, but air drag would change everything.

Sources: Klotz, American Journal of Physics (2015) via Phys.org and Science, Science News ("Falling through the Earth would be a drag"), PBS NOVA
tags: what if you jumped into a hole through the earth
how long to fall through earth

scenes.text: Jump into a hole through Earth, and you'd never land.
You'd fall faster and faster, then race through the core.
Your speed carries you past it, toward the far side.
With no air, a 2015 study found you'd pop out in 38 minutes.
But here's the strange part. Air steals speed every pass, so you'd fall short and drop back, again and again.
Until you hung, weightless, at the center of the planet. So,
